title: Ask twice

character.description: two fictional coworkers in a modern office: a woman in her late twenties with a dark brown bob haircut in a cream blouse, and a woman in her thirties with braided hair in a green cardigan

shots.still: the woman with the bob haircut sits at her office desk giving a forced polite smile, tired sad eyes, late afternoon light, her colleague with braids standing nearby with a coffee
shots.motion: She forces a polite smile and nods, then her smile fades as she looks back at her screen

shots.still: the woman with braids pulls a chair over and sits down beside her colleague's desk, leaning in with a caring concerned look, soft window light
shots.motion: She sits down beside her colleague and leans in, listening with a caring look

shots.still: the woman with the bob haircut finally talking openly, relieved, eyes a little teary with a small grateful smile, her colleague listening warmly beside her, golden hour light
shots.motion: She talks, relieved, wipes a tear and smiles; her colleague nods warmly

texts.text: "I'm fine" is the most common lie.

music.description: gentle lo-fi piano with soft warm pads and a light heartbeat-like pulse, comforting and sincere

post_caption:
"I'm fine" is the most common lie we tell. Next time, ask twice. 🫶

When did someone last really ask how you were?
